name: Heikin Ashi Trend Reversal [Manual Build] [Medium]
raw_text: Heikin Ashi Trend Reversal (New Batch 4, Strategy 1). Bias TF 1H, Entry TF 15m. Standard HA smoothed-candle recalc (own reusable concept). HA flip (own default: computed on the BIAS 1H role) + increasing candle size (body > 5-candle avg, own default) + not-ranging (fewer than 3 flips in the last 10 HA candles, own default) = a confirmed reversal; the reversal candle's own ha_low/ha_high zone, ATR-buffered (0.5x ATR14, own default) as 'near', held until the next opposite flip; entry TF (15m) price returning into that zone fires the trade. Short side is a builder's own mirrored default (source only detailed the long case). SL = recent swing low/high (generic support/resistance, 0.65% buffer, cost_model-verified safe). TP = structure-based (opposing swing level) -- HARD FILTER: min 1:3 RR required, skip if not met. No session restriction. Risk 1% default.
